description: Use this when someone asks about "property tax exemptions for seniors", veteran or disabled-veteran property tax exemptions, disability exemptions, a homestead exemption, or a senior property tax freeze. Works for any US state and county. Takes a state, optionally a county, and the situation (senior, veteran, disabled, homestead). Returns each program with what it does, who qualifies, how and by when to apply, and source links, from Grove Hopper county research, our 50-state roundups and a live search of official pages where needed. Do not use for appealing an assessment (use get_property_tax_appeal_deadline). Can take up to about 25 seconds when the live search is needed. Read-only.

county.description: County name if known, for example "Broward County".

situation.description: One of: senior, veteran, disabled, homestead. Free text is fine, for example "65 and retired".

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, for example "Florida" or "FL".

name: find_property_tax_exemptions
title: Find property tax exemptions
